instructions: Complete the summary using the list of words and phrases, A-J, below.
stem_block:
Sleep, naps and remembering word pairs

Two studies asked how well freshly learned word pairs survive either a night of sleep or a short daytime rest. In the earlier one, different volunteers were placed in a sleeping group and a waking group, while in the later one the same volunteers met both conditions on different days, each spending half an hour on (36) ........ before the final test so that grogginess would not distort it. In the earlier study one group met 80 pairs late in the evening, while the other met the same 80 pairs at (37) ........ ; one of the two groups slept before the recall test and the other did not. The naps in the later study came out shorter than the stretch of time set aside for them, running to (38) ........ and consisting largely of a lighter stage of sleep. Where the two halves of a pair were already close in meaning, the night's effect size reached 0.58 and the daytime rest's (39) ........ . Where no such link existed, the night's effect size was 0.71 and the daytime rest's (40) ........ .

items.prompt: In the earlier one, different volunteers were placed in a sleeping group and a waking group, while in the later one the same volunteers met both conditions on different days, each spending half an hour on (36) ........ before the final test so that grogginess would not distort it.
items.evidence: To reduce the grogginess that can follow a nap and distort test performance, all participants completed a 30-minute puzzle game before their final recall test.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says all participants completed a 30-minute puzzle game before the final recall test, to reduce grogginess; so the correct option is J.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: In the earlier one, different volunteers were placed in a sleeping group and a waking group; the later one instead used a (36) ........ design, so that the very same volunteers went through both a rest and a matching stretch of time without one.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The first experiment used a between-subjects design, meaning that different participants were assigned to a sleep group or a wake group, while the second used a within-subject design in which the same participants experienced both a nap and a period of wakefulness on different days, allowing more direct comparison.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk 'within-subject' terimini hedefliyor ve bu terimin Ingilizcedeki tek tanimi 'ayni katilimcilar her iki kosuldan da gecer'. Ikinci deneyi durustce anlatan her ozet bu tanimi vermek zorunda, yani tanim sizintisi cerceveden degil boslugun hedefinden geliyor. Ustelik ayni ozetteki 37. cumle ilk deneyin iki ayri gruptan olustugunu soyluyor; bankadaki karsit terim C ('between-subjects') boylece ilk deneye baglanip eleniyor ve J elemeyle cikiyor. Tanimi ozetten silmek kalan cerceveyi anlamsiz birakiyor; bankadaki C'yi degistirmek ise J'yi bankadaki tek arastirma-deseni terimi haline getirip sizintiyi buyutuyor. Tek cikis boslugu baska bir ayrintiya tasimak, o da answer'i degistirmek demek - talimat bunu yarim duzeltme sayiyor. E6 bu yuvayi B ya da D paragrafinin baska bir ayrintisina capalamali (haftada en az bir kez sekerleme yapan 34 katilimci, ya da sersemligi azaltmak icin uygulanan 30 dakikalik bulmaca).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski bosluk B/2'ye capaliydi ve 'within-subject' terimini hedefliyordu; cumlenin kendisi terimin tek tanimini veriyor, bankadaki karsit terim de elemeyle cikiyordu. Yeni bosluk B/2'ye hic degmiyor: kanit D/3'e, sersemligi azaltmak icin uygulanan otuz dakikalik etkinlige tasindi (E5'in onerisi). Iki desen adi da bankadan cikarildi ve ikinci deneyin tasarimi artik BOSLUKSUZ metinde anlatiliyor, yani tanim sizintisi kaynagindan kaldirildi. Bankaya iki gercek rakip eklendi ('a quiet walk', ayrica 'in the laboratory' de bu cerceveye oturuyor).

items.prompt: In the earlier study one group met 80 pairs late in the evening, while the other met the same 80 pairs at (37) ........ ; one of the two groups slept before the recall test and the other did not.
items.evidence: The wake group learned the same material at nine in the morning and were tested twelve hours later, at nine that evening, having remained awake throughout.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the wake group learned the same material at nine in the morning and were tested twelve hours later, at nine that evening; so the correct option is B.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: In the earlier study, one group met 80 pairs late in the evening and was tested twelve hours afterwards, while the other met them at the start of the day and remained (37) ........ until an evening test.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The wake group learned the same material at nine in the morning and were tested twelve hours later, at nine that evening, having remained awake throughout.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk 'remained ___ until an evening test' kalibinin ucundaydi. Uyku grubunun karsisina konan grubun uyanik kaldigini soylemek tasarimin kendi mantigi; ozeti durustce yazan her cumle bunu ima ediyor. E7 parcasiz olcumunde uc turun ucunde de dogru bilindi; dayanak logic. Cerceve nasil yazilirsa yazilsin kalibin tek doldurmasi vardi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk ayni cumlede kalibin ucundan kaynagin sectigi SAATE kaydirildi. Ilk denemede cerceve hala 'aksam sinandi, arada uyanik kaldi' diyordu ve 2026-08-18 kor turunda parcayi hic gormeyen cozucu bunu %80 guvenle sabaha cevirdi: aksam sinanan uyanik grup zorunlu olarak sabah ogrenir. Bu yuzden cerceveden hem sinav saati hem de hangi grubun uyanik kaldigi cikarildi; ozet artik yalnizca iki gruptan birinin uyudugunu soyluyor, hangisinin uyudugunu soylemiyor. Kelime bankasina ucuncu bir saat eklendi ('eight in the morning'), boylece on iki saatlik araligi hesaplayan aday bile iki sabah saati arasinda karar veremiyor. Secim yalniz C/3'u okumaya bagli.

items.prompt: The naps in the later study came out shorter than the stretch of time set aside for them, running to (38) ........ and consisting largely of a lighter stage of sleep.
items.evidence: Naps in the second experiment lasted an average of 64.1 minutes and consisted mainly of Stage 2 sleep, a lighter stage than the deep sleep typically associated with the middle of a full night.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says naps in the second experiment lasted an average of 64.1 minutes and consisted mainly of Stage 2 sleep; so the correct option is D.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The naps themselves ran to an average of (38) ........ and were made up largely of a lighter stage of sleep.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Naps in the second experiment lasted an average of 64.1 minutes and consisted mainly of Stage 2 sleep, a lighter stage than the deep sleep typically associated with the middle of a full night.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bankada tek bir ondalikli sure vardi ('64.1 minutes'); rakibi ise yuvarlak ve sozel bir ifadeydi ('an hour and a half'). Cerceve 'an average of' dedigi anda ortalamanin yuvarlak olmayacagi sezgisiyle dogru secenek bicimden okunuyordu. E7 parcasiz olcumunde uc turun ucunde de dogru bilindi; dayanak option_wording.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bankaya ayni bicimde ikinci bir ondalikli sure eklendi ('48.6 minutes'), boylece bicim artik ayirt etmiyor. Cerceveden 'an average of' kalibi cikarildi ve yerine sekerlemelerin ayrilan sureden KISA ciktigi bilgisi kondu; bu, plamlanan bir bucuk saatlik sureyi eliyor ama iki ondalikli sure arasinda karar vermiyor. Secim yalniz F/1'i okuyarak yapilabiliyor.

items.prompt: Where the two halves of a pair were already close in meaning, the night's effect size reached 0.58 and the daytime rest's (39) ........ .
items.evidence: For semantically related word pairs, nocturnal sleep produced a substantially larger improvement in recall than daytime napping did, with a standardised effect size of 0.58 compared with only 0.15 for napping.
items.explanation: Paragraph E gives an effect size of 0.58 for nocturnal sleep and 0.15 for napping with semantically related word pairs; so the correct option is E.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Where no such link existed, however, the picture changed: the two turned out to offer (39) ........ .
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: For unrelated word pairs, however, nocturnal sleep and napping produced very similar benefits, with effect sizes of 0.71 and 0.68 respectively, showing that a nap could match a full night's sleep when the material being learned had no prior connection to existing knowledge.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk 'the picture changed' karsitliginin ucundaydi: bir onceki cumle gece uykusunun cok daha iyi oldugunu soyledigi icin, 'tablo degisti' dendiginde geriye tek anlamli doldurma kaliyordu ('equal benefits'). Karar pasajdan degil ozetin kendi ic mantigindan cikiyordu. E7 parcasiz olcumunde uc turun ucunde de dogru bilindi; dayanak logic.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit ayni pasajin E/2 cumlesine tasindi ve bosluk artik calismanin kendi olctugu sayiya aciliyor (etki buyuklugu). Ozetteki karsitlik cumleleri kaldirildi; iki cerceve de ayni bicimde, yalnizca gece degerini vererek gunduz degerini soruyor. Bankada uc ondalikli deger var (0.70, 0.15, 0.68); yakinlik sezgisiyle secen aday bu kalemde yanlisa gidiyor, cunku 0.58'e en yakin degerler yanlis olanlar.

items.prompt: Where no such link existed, the night's effect size was 0.71 and the daytime rest's (40) ........ .
items.evidence: For unrelated word pairs, however, nocturnal sleep and napping produced very similar benefits, with effect sizes of 0.71 and 0.68 respectively, showing that a nap could match a full night's sleep when the material being learned had no prior connection to existing knowledge.
items.explanation: Paragraph E gives effect sizes of 0.71 for nocturnal sleep and 0.68 for napping with unrelated word pairs; so the correct option is H.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Neither how long a rest ran nor which stages it contained predicted the size of the gain; what counted, the authors argue, was (40) ........ rather than anything about the internal shape of the sleep.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Neither the exact length of a nap nor the particular stages of sleep it contained showed any significant relationship with how much memory improved, suggesting that simply having the opportunity to nap mattered more than its precise internal structure.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cerceve 'rather than anything about the internal shape of the sleep' diyerek uykunun ic yapisina dair butun secenekleri kendi icinde eliyordu; geriye yapisal olmayan tek secenek kaliyor ve cevap pasajsiz cikiyordu. E7 parcasiz olcumunde uc turun ucunde de dogru bilindi; dayanak logic.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit ayni pasajin E/3 cumlesine tasindi ve bosluk calismanin kendi olctugu sayiya acildi. Cerceve artik hicbir secenegi elemiyor: gece degeri veriliyor, gunduz degeri soruluyor. Bankadaki ucuncu ondalikli deger (0.70) 0.71'e cok yakin oldugu icin 'en yakin sayiyi sec' stratejisi de is gormuyor; karar E/3'u okumaya bagli.
